title: fix(objectql)!: uninstalling a base package is refused while its paired .custom package is installed, naming the pair (409)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNxBfysW9RL3L2nLXms3Co9hA)_
Fixes #28408

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `SchemaRegistry.assertPackageUninstallable`, and so `uninstallPackage`, `unregisterObjectsByPackage` without `force`, the protocol's `deletePackage` and `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id`, now refuse the uninstall of a base while the registry holds its paired customization package (`BASE.custom`), an uninstall that succeeded before; nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches uninstalling a package, so every taught use stays true.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:卸载一个基础包(如 HotCRM)时,只要它的配对定制包 `hotcrm.custom` 还装着,卸载就被拒绝,返回 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`,消息点名 `hotcrm.custom`,并先给出路:先删除它(要保留定制,先用 `GET /api/v1/packages/hotcrm.custom/export` 导出)。基础包同时被别的包扩展时,一个拒绝同时列出两种原因。
- 为什么改:不拒的话,卸载会把 `hotcrm.custom` 里的全部定制变成孤儿,没人提供、也没人说明原因(ADR-0146 D3,史诗的两分钟验证「卸载 HotCRM 被拒并点名 `hotcrm.custom`」)。
- 风险与回滚:只是给已有的卸载拒绝(ADR-0029 被扩展对象)加一个原因,同一个错误类、同一个 409 信封,没有新错误码;`deletePackage` 在删存储行之前就问,拒绝时什么都不动。卸载配对包本身、`force`、没有配对包的基础包都不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。另:`DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:id` 这扇门会先删账本再撤注册,配对包在时它仍回 200 并留下半卸载的基础包;它不在本卡文件面内,已作为发现交给席位。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`(`assertPackageUninstallable` 末尾的配对检查,和 `PackageUninstallExtendedError` 构造函数里的三种消息分支)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-uninstall-refuse-before-mutate.test.ts`(新的 describe 块)、`packages/objectql/src/registry-assert-package-uninstallable.test.ts`(新的 describe 块)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-assert-package-uninstallable.test.ts`(需先构建 spec),预期 9 个用例全绿,其中 "the pair present" 用例断言 409 并点名 `hotcrm.custom`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`SchemaRegistry.assertPackageUninstallable(id)`** (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`) also refuses while the registry holds the pair id of `id`, which it reads from N-08's `customizationPackageId` (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`). There is no local copy of the suffix. The pair is found by id alone, so a pair built by the ensure door (N-13) and an installed exported pair are treated the same. Uninstalling the pair itself is unaffected, because a `.custom` id derives no pair. `force` still means not asking.
- **The same refusal, no new code.** `PackageUninstallExtendedError` (`RESOURCE_CONFLICT` / 409, the ADR-0112 envelope) gains `customizationPackageId`. Its message opens with the way out: delete the pair first, exporting it before that to keep its customizations (`GET /api/v1/packages/PAIR/export`). It then names the pair. When the base is also extended (ADR-0029), ONE refusal names the extenders and the pair, and its first sentence is the whole way out. The extender-only message is byte-identical to before. The class keeps its name because ADR-0141 and ADR-0146 cite it as this family's anchor ("the `PackageUninstallExtendedError` shape").
- **Every door that asks it refuses before mutating.** These are `deletePackage` (before its `sys_packages` delete), `uninstallPackage` and `unregisterObjectsByPackage`, and so `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id`. `protocol-package-uninstall.ts` changes only in comments: they now name the pair cause, and they correct the door's answer from `500` to the refusal's own `409`.
- **Wanted 3: gate order unchanged.** On `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id` the read-only `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` still answers first. A new test pins it for a booted code package with its pair installed.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-assert-package-uninstallable.test.ts`, new block (base `hotcrm`, pair `hotcrm.custom`):
  - the pair present: `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` / 409 / `httpStatus` 409, `customizationPackageId: 'hotcrm.custom'`, the way out leading, nothing mutated; `uninstallPackage` throws the same refusal and removes nothing;
  - the pair absent answers as before. So does a `.custom` package that is not this base's pair (`hotcrmx.custom`), and a dependent that is not the pair (`hotcrm.extras`, which ADR-0141 D3 still defers). Both declare the base;
  - both causes: one refusal carrying `extendedObjects`, `extenders` and `customizationPackageId`;
  - the pair itself uninstalls, then the base does; `unregisterObjectsByPackage(base, true)` does not ask.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-uninstall-refuse-before-mutate.test.ts`, new block (real `SchemaRegistry`, real `HttpDispatcher`):
  - pair installed, base disabled first through `PATCH /packages/:id/disable`: the operator's `DELETE` answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the pair. The stored rows, the registry entry (still disabled), its object, the disable record on disk and the pair are all intact;
  - a host with no persisted half: the registry's own uninstall refuses the same way, nothing moves;
  - control: the pair deleted first through the same door (200), then the base uninstalls (200);
  - a booted code package with its pair: `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` first, `deletePackage` never asked.
  - The rig's `protocol` double now asks `registry.assertPackageUninstallable` before its store delete, as `deletePackage` does, and deletes only the base's rows. The existing arms are unchanged and still green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Wanted 3, measured: one door does uninstall a managed base.** `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId` (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, `handleUninstall`) uninstalls a marketplace-installed base. It removes the ledger entry first and asks no refusal before that. The registry's refusal reaches it only at the withdrawal, as a failed `registry.uninstallPackage` cleanup inside a 200. Measured at this head with a real `SchemaRegistry` (a scratch test, not committed):
  - pair installed: `200`, `success: true`, ledger entry gone, base still registered until restart, `cleanups: [{ name: 'registry.uninstallPackage', success: false }]`, and no response field names the pair. Only the operator log does.
  - no pair (control): `200` and the base is withdrawn.
  So on that door the two-minute check does not hold. After a restart the base is gone and its pair is stranded: the half-removed base ADR-0146 D3 rules out. The ADR-0029 extender refusal has the same gap there today, and `marketplace-install-local-uninstall-withdrawal.test.ts` pins it as declared ("a refused withdrawal is one failed outcome on the response"). The fix is to ask `assertPackageUninstallable` before the ledger removal and answer its 409. That is outside this card's file surface (`packages/cloud-connection`), so it is not changed here. It is reported to the seat for a card. The gates on `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id` are not reordered.
- **The prescription.** The card says the refusal "prescribes exporting it … or deleting it first". Exporting alone does not unblock the uninstall, so the message says to delete the pair first and to export it before that to keep its customizations.

## Verification

Readings at head `d79d71aa7` (branch base `ea74ebf93`).

<details><summary>Package tests, typecheck and lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` and `test`: exit 0; Test Files 509 passed (509), Tests 9865 passed (9865).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` and `test`: exit 0; Test Files 288 passed, 4 skipped (292), Tests 21888 passed, 26 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` and `test`: exit 0; Test Files 496 passed (496), Tests 8057 passed, 19 skipped.
- The two touched files alone: objectql 9/9, runtime 9/9 (4 new each).
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide, as the dispatch asked): exit 0.
- All of the above ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, VERDICT command-exit 0, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build` (exit 0). The runtime suite reads `@objectstack/objectql` from `dist/` (no alias), so it ran on the rebuilt package.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs on packages/objectql/src/registry.ts; objectql rebuilt and scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs exit 0 on each mutated and each restored leg)</summary>

Each leg ran both touched files. Each restore leg was proven by the restored blob equal to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, the marker absent from `dist/` (`--absent`, exit 0), and a clean tree at the end.

- A1, the pair is never a cause (`installedPair` always undefined): objectql 2 failed (the pair present; both causes), runtime 2 failed (the 409 with everything intact; the host with no persisted half).
- A2, the registry is not asked whether the pair is installed (refuse whenever an id derives a pair): objectql 5 failed (the pair absent, the pair itself then the base, and the three older arms whose ids derive a pair); runtime 3 failed (both operator uninstalls and the pair-first control).
- A3, with extenders present the pair is dropped from the refusal: objectql 1 failed (both causes); runtime green, as it carries no both-causes door case.

</details>

<details><summary>Dispatch gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 63 commands from 5 paths against merge base `ea74ebf93` (323 changed lines). Every command was run with stdin from `/dev/null`, and each exit code was written to disk before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 7 packages outside the dogfood closure had no `dist/`). After building those 7 it exited 0 (113 require entry points across 70 packages load).
- Every other derived command exited 0, including `pnpm check:type-check-debt`, `pnpm check:engine-double-contract` and `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`.
- The clone was unshallowed (`git fetch --unshallow origin main`) before deriving.

</details>

<details><summary>Full dogfood battery (Clause-② carries the narrowing arm)</summary>

At head `d79d71aa7`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, with no `OS_TEST_SHARD` and no path. VERDICT command-exit 0 (held 20m29s). Test Files 363 passed, 3 skipped (366). Tests 2926 passed, 28 skipped (2954). No failures.

</details>

<details><summary>Wanted 3 measurement</summary>

This was a scratch test in `packages/cloud-connection/src` and was deleted before any commit. It booted the real `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` over a real `SchemaRegistry` holding `com.example.tasksapp` (source `marketplace`, scope `cloud`) and, in one arm, `com.example.tasksapp.custom`. Then it called the door's DELETE route.

- No pair: status 200, ledger entry removed, base withdrawn.
- Pair installed: status 200, `success: true`, ledger entry removed, base and pair both still registered, `cleanups` was `[{ name: 'registry.uninstallPackage', success: false, removed: 0 }]`. No response field names the pair; the operator warn does.

</details>
